build.payoff: A clean timed sprint on real lane geometry; beat the record and your time is the record (persisted, visible at both stations).
build.seam: race-type mission; record persisted in story.flags; advisory lines via news:publish

build.title: The Belt Heartbeat
build.trigger: proximity — inside 900 WU of the Bolus throat
build.sees: a sub-bass pulse every eight seconds, felt before heard, and the HUD's band edges breathe with it — the whole sector contracting on the Bolus's rhythm. Match your thrust to the pulse and your approach is measurably smoother (the biology calms to matched motion).
build.payoff: plus codex entry (bio-rhythm); a mechanic taught entirely by sound.
build.seam: one low oscillator recipe with simTime-mod-8 gate in `src/data/audioRecipes.js` + proximity gate (discoverySound's existing cast/proximity idiom).
hones: (a) audio pulse + proximity gate only; skip the HUD band-edge breathing
(b) audio pulse + proximity gate only; skip the HUD breathing (A H-41)
(c) Audio pulse + proximity gate only; skip the HUD band-edge breathing.

build.title: Shoot the Crown
build.trigger: offered at station_tethys when an aurora season (SP3-021) is forecast — the ordinary mission board
build.sees: "One exposure of the crown from inside the skim corridor while it burns. Don't die; the plate is the deliverable." You fly under the burning limb with the aurora filling the top of the frame and fire the scan pulse.
build.payoff: photography moment + codex entry + small bonus.
build.seam: `src/data/landmarkMissions.js` row (same shape as CAVED_SHAFT_PROBE) with the aurora season as its availability predicate.

build.title: The Shed Panel
build.trigger: sim-time — hash-picked once per season per wreck family, 20 s duration
build.sees: a wreck quietly lets go of a hull panel: a groan (if near), the panel tumbling free in the light, spinning so its lacquer catches sun in slow flashes as it drifts off the site. Nothing explodes. It is just a dead ship becoming more dead, on its own schedule.
build.payoff: plus codex entry (each family sheds a named panel once); quiet, memorable.
build.seam: `place_aftermath_deb_*` fragment donors from `src/data/wreckAftermathDressing.js` spawned as finite props on the seeded schedule; sun flashes are the existing coat.

build.title: The Quiet's Fog Rack
build.where: sector_sker_haven, deep fog off the bazaar approach
build.trigger: fly a straight line through the fog for 60+ seconds without scanner pings (occlusion state)
build.sees: in the fog's dead center, a rack of stored hulls — The Quiet's own, unmarked, airframes the ledger never certified. One berth is empty with a chalk line on the deck where a hull should be, and the chalk line is fresh. Someone is out flying it right now.
build.payoff: flag `quiet_fog_rack`; codex page "The Ledger's Blind Spot"; one Quiet fence at Sker offers a one-time loan of the chalk-line berth's twin.
build.seam: fog occlusion state + POI reveal; codex overlay

build.title: The Long Follow
build.trigger: a seeded racer hull passes the player at speed; fires once; uniqueOnce
build.sees: A racer blows past and, without slowing, tags you on the band: "Keep up or don't." The chase has no purse, no rules, no finish line announced — just a hull ahead that flies beautifully for exactly two minutes and then buys the drinks.
build.payoff: Keep visual contact for 120s (a real proximity check, honestly judged) and the racer introduces themselves at the next bar — a named contact who tips rumors worth credits; lose them and they never mention it again.
build.seam: numbered selfRegistered encounter with a 120s proximity await (vignetteInterpreter 'near'/'trail' awaits); contact reward via barContact flag

build.title: Separate the Dancers
build.trigger: offered at station_drift after the player has witnessed one full binary period
build.sees: "They're grinding each other to gravel. Split them before they're dust." A massline job: latch one boulder, burn against the orbit, and pull the pair apart — the separation moment flings a ring of abraded dust that hangs as a visible scar of the job.
build.payoff: plus small bonus + codex entry (the binary becomes two solitary rocks with a named history).
build.seam: `src/data/landmarkMissions.js` row + ordinary massline physics on the two `asteroidMotion` bodies; dust ring via gas volume.

build.title: The Measured Rock
build.trigger: always present
build.sees: a house-sized boulder with survey pins hammered in every 10 WU along one seam and a brass plate: "STILL SHRINKING. — Gulf Survey, year 12." Fresh filings glitter at the newest pin. Someone has measured it every day for years, and it is measurably, deterministically smaller each visit.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; a joke with a straight face.
build.seam: `src/data/worldOneOffs.js` row (claim-mark + pins via existing prop donors); shrink step keyed to calendar year (deterministic).

build.title: The Blind
build.trigger: proximity to a hunter stakeout while quiet (no weapons hot); cooldownS 86400
build.sees: You drift through a hunter team's comms discipline by accident: target descriptions, shift changes, the quarry's known habits — all in crisp argot, all audible, none of it about you. They are professionals mid-job and the band is their workplace. Then the quarry's engine note passes under everyone, including yours.
build.payoff: Sell the plan to the quarry (they pay, and become a named contact) or sit on it (the takedown happens; you can watch; the hunters tip professionals who stayed out of the line).
build.seam: numbered ambient encounter with overheard-bark arc; bountyHunt coordination as the payload; tips via d.grant

build.title: The Wolf Pack
build.trigger: after event — 60 s after any capital-class kill in the sector, proximity 500 WU
build.sees: scavenger wings arrive in file, cutting lights flashing as they work — green go-lamps over chosen plates, red stop-lamps over contested ones — and the wreck field lights up like a construction site. They strip visibly: plates teeter, detach, get dragged.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; contestable if you want their claim.
build.seam: scavenger presence template + job-signature lights (`emitNpcJobSignature` in `src/render/vfx.js`); aftermath donor plates from `wreckAftermathDressing.js`.

build.title: The Nereid Coupling Riddle
build.trigger: dock a player hull against the empty coupling handshake (physical dock attempt)
build.sees: the coupling completes its handshake with the player's hull out of sheer loneliness — a full freight-platform protocol exchange, nine steps, ending in one honest line: "TANKER: NOT PRESENT. DECADE: ELEVEN. COUPLING: STILL OUT. ARE YOU THE TANKER? [AWAITING VERDICT]" Whatever the player answers, the coupling says "UNDERSTOOD. STILL OUT." and lets go.
build.payoff: codex page "Still Out"; Nereid standing +2; the coupling's handshake thereafter completes for the player in four steps instead of nine ("it remembers the shape").
build.seam: dock-attempt interaction + dialog state; codex overlay

build.title: The Taxidermist
build.trigger: permanent lair site; unlocks after the player survives any hunter encounter
build.sees: A hunter's lair built like a museum: forty hull IDs engraved on the airlock, each with a hull plate from the kill bolted under it, arranged chronologically. There is one empty space at the end, polished, waiting. The current occupant is home, and charming, and absolutely not apologetic.
build.payoff: Trade with the collector (they buy trophies at premium); the empty space is yours if you want it, and the price is a fight with house rules.
build.seam: persistent lair site (authoredPlaces pattern) + vendor encounter; trophy record from deedRecord kill history

build.title: Static Crawl
build.trigger: sim-time — the final 10 s of each warning phase, hulls in open space
build.sees: violet discharge crawls along your own hull's panel seams and pools at the wingtips — the status-matter vocabulary showing electricity hunting for ground. NPCs' hulls show it too, dimmer. When the front hits (surge phase), the crawl snaps off all at once with a tick.
build.payoff: plus codex entry (storm sign); a readable tell that costs nothing.
build.seam: attached status-matter pool (`_statusMatterVfx` owner in `src/render/vfx.js`, DIRTY — request the existing attachment verb) keyed by the warning-phase predicate.

build.title: Dust Shear
build.trigger: sim-time — solar_wind surge, a visible shear wave rolls one named field per surge
build.sees: a front of glowing dust rolls through the rock field and the rocks lean and shiver as it passes — asteroid motion you can see coming, like wind through wheat. Loose ore in the field scatters ahead of the wave.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; rich-mining after the wave passes (fresh exposure).
build.seam: `asteroidMotion` impulse wave keyed by the volume field kernel (one registered sheet field in `src/data/environmentalMachinery.js`).

build.title: The Futures Broker
build.trigger: posted when a convoy carrying a specific commodity is scheduled through the sector
build.sees: A broker offers paper on tomorrow's convoy: "That hull arrives full, price dips, you lose. It arrives empty, price spikes, you win. It arrives at all, that's your problem to arrange." The contract is a bet on a real scheduled convoy.
build.payoff: Escort the convoy (honest win), raid it (profit, wanted), or ignore it (the market moves without you, pillar 4). All three are visible in prices the next day.
build.seam: numbered encounter + economy intents via economyCycles; convoy spawns via convoy script (encounterScripts.js)

build.title: The Metal Garden
build.trigger: proximity to a fixed magnetic spine rock; persistent while inside
build.sees: A magnetic spine so strong that loose hull-plate, bolts and dead drones from a kilometer around hang off it in slow, still fringes — a garden of iron, sorted by mass, swaying when anything passes. Salvage hangs here like fruit. Taking it is possible. The spine takes it back, eventually, from everyone.
build.payoff: Free salvage with an honest gimmick: everything you pull free is dragged back within a day unless you also leave metal (a real trade: the garden keeps its mass); locals leave offerings and the garden grows.
build.seam: numbered anomaly encounter with magnetic attraction forces (bolusForces precedent); mass-balance persistence in story.flags

build.title: The Three Hull Garden's Fourth
build.trigger: the player leaves any wrecked (disabled) hull — their own or a defeated enemy's — within the garden's tether radius for 24+ in-game hours
build.sees: the garden grows a fourth hull: not grown from the dead, but a fourth planter prepared, empty, waiting — sized exactly to the player's hull. A plaque-in-progress is being engraved, slowly, letter by letter, across visits. It currently reads: "GARDENER: [ENGRAVING]."
build.payoff: the garden is claiming the player in the gentlest possible way; flag `garden_fourth_planted`; visiting weekly advances the engraving; full name = the garden stages up and the plaque completes.
build.seam: proximity persistence + garden stage reuse + plaque text state machine

build.title: The Impound Auction
build.trigger: posted when state has ≥1 impounded/confiscated hull record; uniqueOnce per hull
build.sees: The impound yard auctions a confiscated smuggler's ship at 40% book value — payment due on delivery, and delivery means towing her out yourself past three claimant-hulls who also got the notice.
build.payoff: A real ship (sellable or keepable), a race against claimants, and an entry in the yard's ledger that other NPCs reference.
build.seam: wreck/tow mission in src/data/wreckMissions.js WRECK_MISSIONS pattern + tow_recovery type from MISSION_TYPES; hull spawns as disabled entity (1210 pattern)

build.title: Rock Crossing Warning
build.trigger: sim-time — the wire posts a rock-crossing one day ahead; the crossing happens on schedule
build.sees: `WIRE: a 40 m iron crosses the Scar lane tomorrow, second bell. Give it room.` Tomorrow, at exactly the posted minute, it crosses — a dark boulder with three blinking survey lamps and a lit tail of dust, escorted by a bored tender skiff.
build.payoff: plus codex entry (schedule literacy); being there on the minute is its own reward.
build.seam: worldClock news + a deterministic convoy spawned from the calendar row (lane-contact idiom from `src/data/worldOneOffs.js` comments).

build.title: The Wash
build.trigger: sim-time — twice per calm phase, a debris wash crosses the trade lane on a fixed bearing with an 8 s warning stinger
build.sees: a wall of tumbling wreck-fragments sweeps across the lane at hull height, backlit, and for ten seconds the lane is a river of iron. It is the racing set-piece let loose in adventure: hold, dodge, or ride the edge.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; combat-honest (the debris hits).
build.seam: `src/data/racingSetPieces.js` `wave` row shape ported to an adventure weather volume via `environmentalMachinery.js` field registration.

build.title: The Boulder Garden
build.trigger: always present
build.sees: thirty fist-sized rocks in a careful double spiral around a claim post, each on a tiny numbered pedestal of welded scrap — someone's garden, tended. One rock is missing; its pedestal reads "LOST IN THE WIND. REPLANTED SPRING."
build.payoff: plus codex entry; a smile, then a reason to come back next year.
build.seam: `src/data/worldOneOffs.js` cluster row (deterministic offsets, per the file's own law) + claim-post donor.

build.title: The Vigil Array's Request
build.trigger: the Vigil Array's scan catches the player's hull during its nightly sweep (worldCalendar night, proximity)
build.sees: the array hails with a request no chart lists: "VIGIL ROSTER: ONE (1) EMPTY SLOT, NIGHT WATCH. REQUIREMENTS: A HULL. A LIGHT. FOUR HOURS. REWARD: A NAME ON THE WALL." Accepting parks the player's hull in the array's watch pattern — four hours of sim time compressed by the duty cycle — and their callsign is welded to the wall with the vigil's dead.
build.payoff: flag `vigil_named`; the wall is visitable forever; Io standing +4; one-time +5% night-sensor efficiency ("the night knows you now").
build.seam: calendar-window + watch interaction + wall dressing + codex overlay

build.title: The Tether Memorial's New Line
build.trigger: after the player survives any hull event below 10% integrity (near-death record)
build.sees: the memorial's tether wall has a new line — the players' own near-death date and hull, stenciled by no visible hand, in the same paint as everyone else's. A regular at the expanse bar confirms: "The wall hears the maydays. If you lived through one, it knows. That is all the memorial has ever done: know."
build.payoff: flag `wall_knows`; the memorial is a permanent map landmark for the player; one hunter buys the player a drink for "being on the wall the fun way."
build.seam: near-death record + memorial dressing + bar line

build.title: The Kiln Door
build.trigger: sim-time — the kiln's cycle: door every 300 s, burn 40 s
build.sees: the runaway kiln's door irises open on schedule and its interior glow breathes out in three slow pulses, heat shimmer standing off the shell, before the door irises shut mid-breath (it never completes the fourth pulse — that is why they call it runaway). Its light catches nearby rocks like a lighthouse of warmth.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; gives the existing story prop a heartbeat.
build.seam: emissive envelope on the existing story-prop package keyed by simTime; `moment.stinger` cue already attached to it in `src/data/trailerMoments.js`.

build.title: Radiator Bloom
build.trigger: sim-time — vent cycle every 600 s day, ~60 s duration
build.sees: the station's radiator banks bloom to deep red heat over a minute — a slow sunrise along the spine — then vent in visible shimmering sheets and cool back to dark metal. The bloom is bright enough to silhouette any hull crossing it, and pilots use it as a backdrop.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; photography moment.
build.seam: emissive envelope on radiator finishes (Forge emissive gain vocabulary from `lookMoods.js` LOOK_EMISSIVE_GAIN pattern); data-only.

build.title: The Pilgrim Mooring's Guest Book
build.trigger: moor (hold position, low speed) at the mooring for 60+ seconds
build.sees: the mooring's guest book updates with every hull that has ever moored there, in handwriting, the most recent entry always half-finished — because every pilgrim moors mid-thought. The player's entry appears as they settle: "[CALLSIGN], ARRIVED —" and waits, cursor blinking, for the player to actually leave, at which point it reads "ARRIVED. DEPARTED. BETWEEN: EVERYTHING."
build.payoff: flag `mooring_between`; codex page "Between"; Helios standing +2.
build.seam: hold-timer + text state machine + codex overlay

build.title: The Librarian's Grudge

"Hull 4471-T: two survey logs, one black box, one piece of evidence, destroyed." The librarian is not angry. The librarian is keeping score, which is worse.
build.payoff: A permanent reputation as a record-destroyer (or, if you donate records, as a donor — the same ledger, better column); donations are one-click and the librarian's thanks are worth more than the fee.
build.seam: persistent fixture reading destruction events; donations via a dock interaction; ledger state in story.flags

build.title: The False Gate Sparks

build.sees: the gate that never once spun spins — one full rotation, under its own surge, witnessed by every pilot on the march. It turns exactly once and stops facing the door it was welded shut against. The fuel pellets on the rim all ignite at once, a held note, and go out together.
build.payoff: flag `false_gate_turned`; codex page "Once"; the gate's memorial plaque gains a second line: "IT TURNED. [DATE]. WE SAW."
build.seam: seasonal surge window + single-rotation cue + plaque state; codex overlay

build.title: The Rodeo

build.sees: Claim-jumpers run a literal rodeo: they lasso loose boulders from your claim with masslines and drag them out of the beacon ring, whooping, scoring themselves. It's theft as sport and they want an audience.
build.payoff: Re-lasso your own rocks back (a tug-of-war minigame that's just the massline, honestly), shoot their lines, or out-score them by throwing bigger rocks than they do — they'll concede the seam with a tip of the hat.
build.seam: numbered selfRegistered encounter with attachment tug logic; scoring on massline throw events (massline throw precedent in tow_recovery type)

build.sees: relight a dead foundry: tow the ignition slug from the redoubt, seat it in the firebox, and stand back as the stack takes — a rising column of furnace light that, when it catches, visibly floods the sector's ash fields with orange and sets every nearby lamp blinking in celebration.
build.payoff: plus small bonus + codex entry; the light stays as a sector feature (a proper place, not a set-dress).
build.seam: `src/data/sectorWonders.js` build pattern (operations/payloads/receivers) + a registered place record; the relight is a sustained event light.

build.trigger: proximity to a derelict relay on the starter lane; uniqueOnce
build.sees: A Concord relay wreck from before the sector was charted still auto-files every ship that passes — including yours — into a log nobody collects. The filings are oddly kind: "Vessel observed maintaining lane discipline. Noted with approval."
build.payoff: One free "clean transponder" stamp (a one-time shield against a future fine) for anyone who bothers to read the whole log; codex entry.
build.seam: numbered ambient encounter + state.story.flags['relay_stamp'] consumed by patrol_scan fine logic in encounterScripts.js

build.title: The Dead Star Chart
build.where: sector_sedna_dark, drifting wreck of a survey ship
build.trigger: first scan of the wreck
build.sees: the wreck's chart table still displays a star map — but every star is replaced by a tally mark, and one tally is circled. The circled mark corresponds, position for position, to a real uncharted body in the game world that no POI row currently names.
build.payoff: the circled position becomes a real discoverable (a dead precursor pin, Verge-Layer register); codex page "The Surveyor's Last Map."
build.seam: scan overlay copy + one new POI row placed at the circled offset; codex overlay in src/data/codexPages.js

build.title: Fourth Copy Exists
build.where: sector_nyx_march, the False Gate memorial ring
build.trigger: scan the never-spun jump ring after copying any sealed secret with Quill (flag gate)
build.sees: the ring's memorial plaque has been amended in fresh engraving: "COPIED. NOW IT EXISTS TWICE. THEN I COPIED THE COPY. NOW IT EXISTS ENOUGH." The engraving is AR-3's stamp.
build.payoff: continuity payoff for the Quill thread; Archive rep +2 (they approve of redundant record-keeping on principle).
build.seam: scan copy gated on the Quill copy flag; engraving is a texture/text row; both data-level

build.title: The Previous Tenant's Mail
build.trigger: first mail delivery after the player buys their second hull (ship:purchased)
build.sees: one letter arrives addressed to the PREVIOUS operator of the new hull: "TO: [old reg] / RE: THE SEAT CUSHION YOU TOOK. WE NOTICED. WE HAVE NOT FORGIVEN. THE CUSHION WAS LOAD-BEARING SOCIALLY."
build.payoff: pure mail-channel comedy; flag `cushion_letter`; the station bar gains one regular who is the letter's author.
build.seam: mail.js row with SHIP + ship:purchased trigger; bar regular via barContacts canonical contact pattern

build.title: The Skimmer Shift
build.trigger: sim-time — first watch of any day, proximity 500 WU of the corridor
build.sees: a line of harvest barges works the corridor with running lights on, each dragging a heat-scoop glow that reads as a string of amber lanterns along the band. They hail you with corridor etiquette; cut through their line and the last barge flashes its floods at you — annoyance, not law.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; world-alive texture that rewards polite flying with a comms nod.
build.seam: zone presence (civilian template) + job runtime (miner/hauler jobs persist under `data.npcJobs`, saveVersion v12).

build.title: The Pilgrim's Rest
build.trigger: always present; one plate per season, deterministic
build.sees: a dead tug with dozens of hull plates welded to its flanks like votives — each plate a crew's mark, name and sector stamped, the newest still bright-edged. Someone left a working lamp on the stern, powered by a scrap panel, that has not gone out.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; one plate per season means returning pilots see it grow.
build.seam: `src/data/worldOneOffs.js` row + plate donors; the growth is a seeded-count read.

build.title: The Third Stool's Letter
build.where: any sector, after docking at Quinn's bar 10+ times (dock counter)
build.trigger: the 10th dock triggers one mail delivery
build.sees: "FROM: QUINN / RE: YOUR STOOL / The third stool has been reupholstered. The old cover is in the lost-property column under 'evidence.' Nobody asked for it back. You are the only person who sat there and left the seat warm instead of the tab long. This is not sentiment. It is inventory. — Q"
build.payoff: bar greeting changes permanently ("Your stool. Same one."); +1 to all bar-contact mission payouts at that station for the rest of the game (tiny, real).
build.seam: mail.js row keyed to a dock-count stat; greeting variant + payout nudge in src/ui/station/barContacts.js

build.title: The Yard Wire Newsletter
build.trigger: every 30th in-game day (deterministic cadence)
build.sees: "PITBORN YARD WIRE, VOL. 14: THIS MONTH WE BALLASTED 3 SKIFF BALLS, 1 TENDER BALL, AND A CONCORD SURVEY BUOY NOBODY CLAIMED. 'COUNT 'EM' REMAINS THE WHOLE SONG. REMINDER: CIVILIAN HULLS ARE SACROSANCT. EVERYTHING ELSE IS INVENTORY."
build.payoff: pure voice; the newsletter's stats rotate real yard figures (the Cull meter's actual numbers, interpolated).
build.seam: mail.js spam row with live-stat token interpolation (marketNews token pattern)

build.title: The Survivor's Lamp
build.trigger: after event — a crew-pod ejects from any kill; 4-minute life window
build.sees: a pod with one hand strobe blinking a slow, manually operated pattern — not quite SOS, just "here." Latch it and the strobe goes steady (calm). Tow it to any berth and the pod's lamp joins the station's bunting for a day. Miss the window and the strobe's last blink is the only record.
build.payoff: plus small bonus + reputation nod; a mercy mechanic rendered entirely in light.
build.seam: payload entity + lamp states + docking receipt; no new systems beyond data rows.

build.title: The Karaoke Bell
build.where: bar of station_forge (Foundry), at shift bell
build.trigger: dock at the exact shift bell (worldCalendar) with bar pressure above threshold
build.sees: the whole Foundry rail sings the shift change — the Pitborn "COUNT 'EM" cadence, adopted by DMC foundry crews who will not admit where they learned it. The bell harmonizes. One engineer harmonizes better than the bell and is resented for it.
build.payoff: pure warmth; flag `heard_the_count_sung`; Pitborn rep +1 (they heard about it too and are delighted).
build.seam: bar audio/ambient row keyed to shift bell + barPressureAt (src/data/stationLife.js seam); flag write

build.title: The Beacon's Last Light
build.trigger: after event — a wreck record reaches fully-stripped state (salvage completed)
build.sees: the wreck's marker lamp — which has burned steadily since the wreck was logged — dims, blinks twice, and goes dark for good. The field is officially done. Scavengers' go-lamps stand down one by one after it.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; the end of a story told by one lamp.
build.seam: aftermathWreck record state → lamp removal; the marker lamp already exists in the wreck dressing path.

build.title: The Cartographer's Corner
build.trigger: the player has filed 5+ survey signals (signal:surveyFiled receipts)
build.sees: a corner table where Veil researchers re-plot the player's own survey fixes for fun, arguing about one — the player's "impossible" fix from a storm-surge night. They offer to buy it: not the data, the STORY of flying it.
build.payoff: a lore-read exchange (one screen rendering the player's actual logged route in dry field-guide voice); Veil standing +2; codex page "Impossible Fixes."
build.seam: barContacts lore-read offer keyed to survey counter; codex overlay

build.title: The Bar Bet That Is Real
build.trigger: talk to the rail twice in one sitting (contact-visit counter)
build.sees: two rock crews argue about whether a loaded hauler can clear the Belt Outpost approach rock on a cold coast. They bet. One turns to the player: "You have a hull. Settle it." The job: fly the approach, loaded to exactly the hold's stated max, engine cold, once.
build.payoff: success pays both crews' pooled stake (they were betting ON the player's side, they explain); fail costs nothing but one line: "Well. Now we know." Either way a bar story the regulars retell with the player's actual numbers.
build.seam: one-off mission data + approach-corridor geometry check; barContacts dialogue state

build.title: The Wake Market
build.where: sector_pallas_drift, a fixed coordinate on the player's habitual route
build.trigger: permanent site; inventory persists and updates
build.sees: A scavenger has set up shop at the exact point where your habitual route crosses his — because everything you've ever jettisoned, dropped, or lost settles here on the slow drift, and he has been collecting. "Your wake pays better than most wrecks. Don't take it personal. I also sell it back."
build.payoff: A buy-back shop for your own history (cargo you dumped days ago at a panic price, at a markup that is somehow fair); the shop's stock is literally your past.
build.seam: jettison-event log → shop inventory at a persistent site; buy-back via d.charge

build.title: Hail of Ore
build.trigger: after event — meteor_shower surge ends over a named field
build.sees: as the front clears, the field rains glitter — loose ore shaken free of the rocks catches the returning key light as a slow golden snowfall for a minute, settling onto the rocks. Anything you scoop during the fall is free.
build.payoff: plus small bonus; a post-storm payday ritual pilots will wait for.
build.seam: mining yield pickup vocabulary (`mining:yield` path) with an authored emission window; light is just the returning key.

build.title: First Snow
build.trigger: sim-time — the two cold seasons of each year
build.sees: the sector's dust acquires a slow, falling drift of bright motes that settle on hull tops and stay — ships fly with dusting of white that sheds when you thrust. Rock fields read softer; the whole sector lowers its voice.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; a seasonal identity for Pallas that costs nothing.
build.seam: gas-volume particle row keyed by season hash; shedding on thrust via the existing trail emission gate.
hones: (a) gas-volume falling motes only; hull-settling and thrust-shedding are bespoke particle attachment - cut them, keep the season
(b) gas-volume motes only; cut hull-settling and thrust-shedding (A H-37)
(c) Gas-volume falling motes only — nothing settles or sheds dust in vacuum; cut the hull-settling, keep the season.

build.title: The Dog Watch Knot
build.trigger: sit at the rail during the dog watch (specific shift phase)
build.sees: off-duty patrol pilots run a standing puzzle on the table — a physical massline knot nobody has undone in eleven months. The rules are one sentence: "No tools, one hand, no hands but yours if you are the guest." If the player solves it (a small radial-sequence interaction), the room goes quiet, then buys the player's drinks forever.
build.payoff: flag `knot_undone`; free drinks at Coalition bars permanently; +2 Concord rep ("patience under watch").
build.seam: bar mini-interaction via the radial/choice UI (commsRadial offer pattern in src/ui/commsRadial.js); flag write

build.title: The Anchor Drag
build.trigger: fires when a scheduled freight column passes the belt; uniqueOnce per column
build.sees: The illegal one: latch a moving freight train and hold — no winching, no slack, just nerve and a line rated for less than this. The record is chalked on the last car. The railway does not endorse this. The railway rates your line, loudly, by name.
build.payoff: Hold-time competition against a posted record (physics-pure: tension, breaking thresholds); the record-holder's identity is a legend you can meet.
build.seam: numbered selfRegistered encounter reading attachment tension telemetry (src/combat/attachments.js); record in story.flags

build.title: The Kepler Unbroken Offer
build.trigger: scan the ring of dead corvettes, then dock at station_kepler_scar
build.sees: the hunters' exchange offers the only job the mast has ever generated: "THE MAST WON THE BATTLE. NOBODY KNOWS WHAT THE BATTLE WAS ABOUT. GO ASK IT." The job is a 10-minute listen at the mast with an exchange-issue decoder rig: the mast's log is one line, repeated for years: "STILL THEIRS. STILL HOLDING. STILL WINNING." Nobody knows who "they" are. The exchange pays for the ambiguity.
build.payoff: credits + codex page "Still Winning"; the rig becomes a permanent inventory item that pings mast-like structures sector-wide.
build.seam: one-off mission + listen interaction + inventory item; codex overlay

build.title: The Bedtime Bell
build.where: bar of station_helios, at the late bell
build.trigger: dock during the last shift of the station-day cycle (worldCalendar)
build.sees: the bar's lights drop to ember level and the day regulars file out in strict reverse order of arrival — nobody agreed to this, everyone obeys it. The last one out holds the door. The barkeep locks nothing: "The bell locks it. The bell has never once been wrong about the day being over."
build.payoff: pure atmosphere; flag `bedtime_bell`; one-line codex page (Helios: "the bar closes in reverse order of arrival").
build.seam: bar lighting/dressing keyed to shift phase; codex overlay

build.title: The Tent City
build.where: any station sector, festival days only
build.trigger: sim-time — festival days; dressing cluster spawns at the station's lee
build.sees: a cluster of habitat pods and awning frames grows at the station's lee side for the day — warm window rows, tether-line laundry, one string of lamps — and strikes again at midnight. The same families in the same spots each time (deterministic offsets).
build.payoff: visual wonder only; festivals have geography.
build.seam: everyday/wreck kit donors from `src/data/everydaySpaceKitDressing.js` on a festival-keyed dressing stream (seeded, per the dressing salt idiom).

build.title: Shelter Advisory
build.where: any sector with an active surge
build.trigger: sim-time — surge start, stations broadcast
build.sees: `SHELTER ADVISORY: surge until second bell. Apron lights doubled, berths half price.` Docking during the surge shows doubled apron work-lights and the wire confirms the fee cut — weather touching economy through one line.
build.payoff: plus small bonus (dock fee cut); teaches that stations respond to weather.
build.seam: worldClock popup + the existing station-side-event director reaching `spawnStationSideEventStreak` (apron light streaks) in `src/render/vfx.js`.

build.title: The Paper Plane
build.trigger: sim-time — one launch per year, hash-picked minute; 20 s flight
build.sees: a pod bay ejects something tiny: a folded hull plate with a lamp on it, gliding a slow arc across the apron's light, gaining speed, and burning up against the apron's heat wash in a brief silver flash. The wire never mentions it.
build.payoff: plus codex entry if witnessed (a two-line mystery: "who folds these?").
build.seam: one small prop on a deterministic ballistic path + coat glint + one `explosionBreach` cue light at burnout; all pooled.
hones: (a) ballistics, not gliding: a folded plate thrown on a computed arc, burning in the heat wash; the thrower is the mystery (adopted from C)
(b) ballistics: a folded plate on a computed arc; the thrower is the mystery (C)
(c) Nothing glides in vacuum — ballistics: a folded plate thrown on a computed arc, burning in the apron’s heat wash; the thrower is the mystery.

build.title: The Whisper Buoy
build.trigger: proximity — inside 100 WU, one replay per visit
build.sees: the lane marker's speaker crackles and plays forty seconds of year-old traffic chatter — real recorded-idiom voices from the sector's own contact ledger, degraded — then stops mid-word. The wire has no comment. It does this once per visit, never the same transcript twice in a row.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; the lane's memory.
build.seam: comms popup sequence with degraded audio recipes (bandpass + noise recipes exist) fed from contact deed memory (`src/data/contactDeedMemory.js` exists as a ledger).

build.title: The Hitchhiker
build.trigger: sim-time — hash-picked once per week, proximity 150 WU of the lane
build.sees: a lone EVA suit with a hand strobe drifting near the lane, arm raised, slowly tumbling. Latch it (massline) and it knocks politely on your hull — a comms line, a small fee, and it asks to be dropped at any berth. Two suits exist per seed; one of them is lying about being alive.
build.payoff: plus codex entry (the second suit is an anomaly payoff).
build.seam: pickup entity with comms line via `contactHail` idiom + massline carry; strobe via lamp channel.

build.title: The Magazine
build.trigger: after event — a hull flagged munitions-heavy dies intact
build.sees: no immediate blast: ten seconds of interior flashes through the wreck's window rows — cook-off lighting the ship from inside, room by room — then the magazine goes and the hull opens along its seams in one slow bloom.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; dread instead of noise.
build.seam: window-row emissive sequence via lamp-bus + delayed rupture via the existing phased-explosion vocabulary (`emitExplosionPhase`).

build.title: The Census
build.trigger: border census on its seeded schedule; fires once per census year
build.sees: The Meridian census is physical: three questions, each with a required action, not an answer — "Dump one unit of anything and tell us what it was. Flash your lights twice for the record. Name the last hull you refused." The census taker writes it all down without comment. Your answers become a row in a ledger nobody can edit.
build.payoff: The census row is permanent (persisted) and one future encounter — a census follow-up — opens by quoting it back to you, word for word, five years later.
build.seam: numbered selfRegistered encounter with physical-response choices; row stored in story.flags; follow-up with gates.requiresCompletedShape

build.title: The Cooling Cinder
build.trigger: after event — any capital kill
build.sees: the largest surviving fragment glows reactor-blue and cools through the black-body colors over three minutes — a visible clock on the wreckage. Its light lands dimly on neighboring debris. Salvagers read its color from across the field to time their approach.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; honest thermal aftermath.
build.seam: emissive ramp on the wreck's largest donor plate (`wreckAftermathDressing` fresh variants) keyed to simTime since death; persisted via the wreck record.

build.title: The Loss Notice
build.trigger: after event — any named NPC hull the player personally saw die, read on the next day's wire
build.sees: `LOST: the Harriet Wren, with all records. Killed in the Belt under flags of trade.` One line, the chronicler's voice, for hulls the player witnessed — the game remembering that you were there.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; consequences rendered as memory.
build.seam: chronicler kill facts (already recorded) + worldClock news on the day boundary; zero new sim.
hones: (a) rename the lost hull off "Harriet Wren" - the protagonist is Wren; ordinary name pool (adopted from C)
(b) rename the lost hull off Wren (C); the chronicler needs no coincidence
(c) Rename the lost hull from an ordinary name pool — the protagonist is Wren; the chronicler’s line needs no coincidence.

build.title: Your Receipts, Read Aloud
build.trigger: fires after 20+ market transactions; uniqueOnce; dock proximity
build.sees: A data-broker has your purchase history and reads the three funniest entries over open band: "Sixty units of water ice, bought at panic prices, sold at panic prices, to the same station. Beautiful. Frame it."
build.payoff: Buy the transcript (it's a real codex page of your own stats, gently roasted) or shut him up (he sells it anyway; you hear it later from an NPC).
build.seam: numbered dock encounter reading economy transaction history; codex page in src/data/codexPages.js

build.title: The Sniffer
build.trigger: every fueling, low chance (seeded)
build.sees: The line inspector taps your tank, listens, and reads your week back to you from the fuel: "Three hard burns, one cold soak, and somebody ran you rich for about a minute — chase? Race? Either way, your mixture's honest. Sign here." The paperwork is real. The insight is free.
build.payoff: Flavor with one true detail per reading (drawn from actual flight telemetry); the inspector remembers regulars and asks after the chase by name if it was a race.
build.seam: dock comms popup reading recent flight telemetry summary; inspector memory in story.flags

build.title: The Scuttle
build.trigger: after event — a captained NPC hull dies while disabled, not destroyed (seeded crew choice)
build.sees: the captain scuttles with ceremony: engines flare once to center the hulk, every lamp dies in bow-to-stern order, the comms band carries one clipped sentence, and only then does the scuttle charge open the spine. A death with manners.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; witnessable repeatedly, never identically.
build.seam: kill-path variant keyed to entity data flag + lamp-bus extinguish sequence + one comms popup; all pooled systems.

build.title: The Hum at Sker
build.where: sector_sker_haven (one seeded bearing off the black market)
build.trigger: proximity + stillness — hold position (thrust under 5%) inside the 80 WU zone for 30 s
build.sees: a low hum you half-noticed all over Sker resolves, at exactly this bearing, into a slow melody — the yard's cranes, pumps and welders are all (it turns out) in tune, and from here they compose. Move, and it degrades back into machinery.
build.payoff: plus codex entry; a listening place in the loudest sector.
build.seam: proximity+stillness gate → duck all other audio and unmute a chord mix of existing ambient recipes; pure audio-bus work.

build.title: Laundry Day
build.trigger: sim-time — once per week per station, hash-picked watch, ~4 minutes
build.sees: the station vents steam in fat white puffs while, on the sunward side, a line of suit figures drifts on tethers shaking out laundry sheets that catch the light like sails. The sheets flash silver when they fill. It is the least dramatic and most alive thing in the sector.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; scale contrast — the game's largest and smallest things in one frame.
build.seam: gas puffs + cloth-line proxy props (place donors) with a simTime-keyed sway; no physics cost.

build.title: The Surveyor's Rest
build.trigger: always present
build.sees: an old survey buoy with a folding chair welded beside it and a mug rail holding three mugs — one for each shift, the plate says. The buoy's lamp is warm, not standard white. Someone's whole career fits in a 12 WU circle.
build.payoff: plus codex entry.
build.seam: `src/data/worldOneOffs.js` row (buoy + chair donors), zero agency.

build.title: The Number Station
build.trigger: sim-time — daily at a hash-picked minute, open channel
build.sees: a flat voice reads seven digits, pauses, reads seven more, and signs off with no callsign. Across days the numbers (the codex discovers) count something real: the digit pairs match the sector's weather phases, three ahead. It is a forecast, sent to no one.
build.payoff: plus codex entry (a real, if odd, forecast source).
build.seam: worldClock timed popup + `weatherSeasonAt` read three seasons out (pure); voice is one degraded recipe.

build.title: The Tether Note
build.trigger: after event — massline held at above 95% alignment with the key light's bearing for 3 s
build.sees: the taut line begins to sing — a clean harmonic that rises with tension — and the line itself shows a faint standing-wave shimmer. Cut it at the peak and the note resolves down a fifth. A perfectly useless, perfectly physical instrument.
build.payoff: plus codex entry ("the pilot's tuning fork").
build.seam: tension telemetry already exists on the massline; one oscillator keyed to it + shimmer via the existing cable surface vocabulary (`masslinePresentation` family).

build.title: The Flag Change
build.trigger: permanent wreck with a seeded weekly "owner"; state persists
build.sees: The good wreck in the field changes hands like a fishing spot: Concord claims it Monday, a scavenger crew strips it lawfully Tuesday, the Reach taxes the scavengers Wednesday, and by Friday three flags fly on one mast and nobody can say who owns what. The flags are real fabric props, replaced by someone, every time.
build.payoff: A living landmark whose current flag honestly predicts the encounter you get there this week (patrol scan / share / toll); reading the flags correctly is a learnable skill the game never explains.
build.seam: numbered encounter with seeded weekly variant pick at site; flag as a visual prop (visualOverrides); three script reuses

build.title: The Curtain Rises
build.trigger: sim-time — ion_storm season, warning phase (30 s), at the forecast bearing from `SEASONAL_WEATHER_VOLUMES`
build.sees: the ion front arrives visibly — a slow wall of violet curtain-light leaning across the sector from the forecast bearing, its leading edge throwing flickers on every hull it passes, closing to surge in 30 seconds exactly as the forecast says. You can outfly it, face it, or dock.
build.payoff: visual wonder only; the warning phase is already timed data.
build.seam: weather volume field presentation (fields register in the ONE kernel via `src/data/environmentalMachinery.js`) + gas-volume color ramp via `vfx._gas` vocabulary.
